evals.name: trigger-meta-injection-site
evals.prompt: Where does the meta title and description get injected for a new public page in this app? I need to add SEO tags for a new pricing page.

assertions.text: Identifies src/entry-server.js (generateHead / resolvePageMeta) as the injection point, driven by route meta.title/meta.description i18n keys defined in src/router.js — not a seo.config.js (this skill states none exists)

evals.name: trigger-hreflang-set
evals.prompt: I'm adding a new public route /pricing. What hreflang tags does it need, and does the 404 page need them too?

assertions.text: States hreflang alternates for en, fr, and x-default (pointing at the en URL) are required for indexable public routes, and correctly states 404 pages carry no canonical and no hreflang per the meta.robots/statusCode 404 branch

evals.name: trigger-sitemap-generator
evals.prompt: I just added a new public /pricing page, fully indexable. What do I need to touch so it shows up in the sitemap?

assertions.text: Points to server.js's generateSitemap and the publicPaths array as the place to add the new path, notes robots.txt/sitemap.xml are dynamically generated (never static files under public/), and correctly delegates the actual server.js edit to the server agent rather than doing it itself
